QuestInfo.name: Delivering the Weird Medicine
QuestInfo.1: I gave the #b#t4031011##k to #p102# in #m10000000# and received #b#t4031009##k in return. Now, all I need to do is get this to #b#p207##k, and I'll finally be done. The deeper I get into this, the more I regret saying yes. Anyway, this medicine looks quite tasty. If I ever find myself thirsty and without any water, maybe I should just drink it myself. Hahaha...
QuestInfo.2: I went back to #m10001000# and handed #p207# the Weird Medicine. Hopefully it'll help her get better. As a sign of thanks, #p207# gave me some Mesos and a #b#t1002081##k. The hat... I mean, it looked like it'd protect me from the sun, but it was so old and raggedy... And when I put it on, it made this weird noise... It felt like insects were moving around inside it... Am I going to be okay?

0.0: Thank you!! We can finally use this medicine properly now. It seems that #b#p207##k from #b#m10001000##k has fallen ill again. If you bring this to her, it should help ease her condition a little...

1.0: Darn... My whole body's aching... What, oh my... Isn't that the #b#t4031009##k?? How did you get it?? Wow, you must be amazing.
1.1: Um... Is it okay if I have that? I'll give you something that I don't really need in return... I urge you... please... I need that medicine...

yes.0: Thank you so much... this may cure my longtime sickness after all... here's something I don't really need... hopefully it'll help you through your journey... here are some mesos too, as a sign of my appreciation...

npc.0: Hurry and give #p207# the #b#t4031009##k that I gave you. #m10001000# is very far from here, so make sure you don't lose it along the way...!

item.0: Haven't met #b#p102##k yet? #p102# from #b#m10000000##k can definitely help you find #t4031009#. Please find him.

lost.0: Thank you!!! Please take this medicine in return. #b#p207##k from #b#m10001000##k is sick again. This will take care of the sickness a little bit...
